subject: Post-demo: Grove Retail trial — scope redistribution, success criteria & owners
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Li <aaron.li@groveretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed redistribution of trial scope and next steps

Aaron — thanks again for the demo slot this morning. Helpful conversation; I wanted to capture our recap and propose a concrete way to handle the scope changes you requested so we can lock timelines.

Quick recap of ask from call:
- Grove wants the trial to include two additional intents: "store-locator paraphrase" and "promo-match" (low-latency reranking across catalog metadata).
- You'd like stricter acceptance criteria for false positives on "promo-match" (target precision >= 92% on the top-1 result).
- Requested extension of trial evaluation window by one week to accommodate a weekend sales event.

Proposed approach (goal: re-baseline without blowing SLA or delivery dates)
1) Scope redistribution (see attached Grove_Trial_Roadmap_v1.xlsx):
   - Core conversation routing (original plan) remains primary: we will keep the production-quality intent routing P0 work in the original two-week sprint.
   - Add a narrow "promo-match" reranker as P1: we will prototype with a sampled product feed and a lightweight reranking model (Redwood-optimized quantized variant). P1 will run in parallel but gated from the main acceptance criteria.
   - Add "store-locator paraphrase" as experimental P2: limited to a 10% user sample for throughput and latency measurements.
2) Acceptance criteria adjustments:
   - Core routing: maintain original latency SLO (p95 <= 180ms) and recall targets.
   - Promo-match: new precision target >= 92% top-1 on the evaluation set we curate together; allow recall tradeoff if precision target met.
   - Paraphrase path: latency p95 target <= 300ms at sample rate; functional correctness check via 200 seeded queries.
3) Timeline and owners:
   - Trial start remains Aug 31 — first routing sprint (Evelyn + Ben).
   - Promo-match prototype: Sep 3–9 (Ben lead; Grove devs provide product feed by Sep 1).
   - Evaluation window extended one week: now Sep 14 end-date.
   - Monica to own success criteria sign-off and data collection plan (monica.patel@redwood.ai).
4) Docs & next steps:
   - I attached a draft SOW and an updated roadmap. Please review the toy eval checklist (eval-checklist-v2.csv) and confirm which promo SKUs are high priority.

Ask of Grove this week:
- Aaron/Maya: confirm product feed delivery by EOD Sep 1 (CSV or S3 link).
- Confirm you can accept a 10% sample for paraphrase while we measure performance.
- Approve the adjusted precision target or propose a counter number.

If this sounds right I’ll send a short amendment to the trial SOW we can both sign (DocuSign link to follow) and we’ll spin up the promo-match prototype.

—
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0132


-----Original Message-----
From: Aaron Li <aaron.li@groveretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@groveretail.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:02:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed redistribution of trial scope and next steps

Thanks Evelyn — that matches my notes. A couple of clarifications from our side: 
- Promo-match precision >= 92% is reasonable, but we need to make sure the evaluation set includes seasonal promos (our concern is brittle rules during sale spikes).
- The product feed is small (under 500k SKUs); we can deliver a CSV export and an S3 link.
- For paraphrase, 10% sample fine, but we want visibility on false negatives — can you capture the misses for review?

We agree to the one-week extension; our event runs Sep 11–12 so ending Sep 14 works better. Please include a short list of required fields in the product feed (title, sku, category, promo_tag) so our engineering team can map it.

Aaron
Aaron Li
Head of AI | Grove Retail
aaron.li@groveretail.com


-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Li <aaron.li@groveretail.com>, Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@groveretail.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed redistribution of trial scope and next steps

Looping in technical details and a quick viability note:
- For promo-match, I recommend starting with our quantized reranker (q4_128) which gives good latency/cost balance. We can run it in inference-only mode and keep caching enabled for product title prefixes.
- Required product feed fields: sku, title, merchant_category, price, promo_tag, image_url (optional), updated_at. I will add a short parser to the trial repo to normalize fields.
- For evaluation: I’ll produce a seeded eval set of 400 queries (80% historical queries + 20% synthetic promotional variants). We’ll compute precision@1, MRR, and annotate top failure cases for your review.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: promo-matcher-approach.md (stated in repo)


-----Original Message-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Li <aaron.li@groveretail.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed redistribution of trial scope and next steps

Aaron — thanks for the quick confirmation. I’ll own the evaluation plan and sign-off process. Next steps on my side: 
- I will share a short rubric (pass/fail thresholds + sampling rules) by Wed Aug 26.
- I’ll create a shared evaluation board (Google Sheet) and a simple tagging workflow so Grove can flag failure cases and we can triage.

Please reply with the S3 link or attach the export when available and I’ll map the required fields to our eval pipeline.

Looking forward to getting this started — will send the rubric Wednesday.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: Grove_Trial_Roadmap_v1.xlsx; SOW-draft-Grove-2026-08-22.pdf; eval-checklist-v2.csv
